Three sourced sentences per city in English, Italian and German; name/history first.

en: Earlier called Mahal, it was traditionally known as the King's Island.
Its seventeenth-century Friday Mosque was built from coral stone.
The royal palace and fortifications were dismantled after the monarchy ended in 1968.
it: Un tempo chiamata Mahal, era tradizionalmente conosciuta come l’isola del re.
La sua Moschea del Venerdì, del Seicento, fu costruita in pietra corallina.
Il palazzo reale e le fortificazioni furono smantellati dopo la fine della monarchia nel 1968.
de: Früher Mahal genannt, war sie traditionell als Insel des Königs bekannt.
Ihre Freitagsmoschee aus dem siebzehnten Jahrhundert wurde aus Korallenstein erbaut.
Der Königspalast und die Befestigungen wurden nach dem Ende der Monarchie 1968 abgetragen.
